name: Intimate Massage with Snowleopard Lady
storyline:
To ensure the healthy growth of beastman children, she founded the Beastman High School.

However, ever since losing her husband years ago, she has buried herself in work to numb the pain.

Strong and respected, yet deep within her heart lies unhealed solitude.

Now, she seeks a true “place to belong.”
summary: Fully animated with Live2D!! Experience immersive interaction with both front & back positions and a variety of tools! Following “The Fox Lady”, this is a seductive furry-touch game made for kemono lovers!
